Threat: An attacker may attempt to access an account using invalid credentials
Recommendation: Maintain secure password verification and consider login rate limiting

Threat: An authenticated user may delete another user's task by manipulating the task ID
Potential Impact: Unauthorised deletion and loss of user data
Existing Control: GET and PUT endpoints check task ownership but DELETE does not
Test/Evidence: SEC-006 confirmed that User A successfully deleted User B's task
Recommendation: Add user_id ownership filtering to the DELETE database query and verify affected rows

Threat: A user may deny performing an action if sufficient activity records are unavailable
Potential Impact: Limited ability to investigate suspicious actions or identify responsible users
Existing Control: Audit logging was not verified during this testing
Test/Evidence: No audit-log test has been conducted
Recommendation: Consider recording important security events with user identity and timestamps

Threat: An attacker may attempt to retrieve another user's task data
Existing Control: GET endpoint checks both task ID and user ID and returns a generic 404 response
Test/Evidence: SEC-004 returned 404 Not Found when User A attempted to view User B's task
Recommendation: Continue enforcing ownership checks and avoid exposing sensitive internal errors

Threat: An attacker may send excessive requests or resource-intensive requests to affect application availability
Potential Impact: Reduced availability and degraded application performance
Existing Control: Rate limiting and resource protections were not verified
Test/Evidence: No dedicated denial-of-service test has been conducted
Recommendation: Consider rate limiting request handling and monitoring server resources

Threat: A user may perform actions on resources belonging to another user without permission
Potential Impact: Unauthorised access to another user's data and operations
Existing Control: GET and PUT ownership checks are implemented but DELETE lacks an ownership condition
Test/Evidence: SEC-004 and SEC-005 passed while SEC-006 failed
Recommendation: Apply consistent server-side authorisation checks to every task operation
